curated_items.title: Codex CLI Release: 0.144.0
curated_items.summary: New Features Usage-limit reset credits now show their type and expiration, and let you choose which credit to redeem. ( #30488 ) Added a writes app-approval mode that allows declared read-only actions while prompting for writes. ( #30482 ) MCP tools can now request authentication interactively without an experimental opt-in. ( #28772 ) App-server hosts can provide Codex authentication at runtime and redirect successful logins to a hosted page. ( #28745 , #31274 ) Global pnunen installs are now detected so diagnostics and updates use the correct package manager. ( #31503 ) Selecting Ultra reasoning now warns when high multi-agent concurrency could increase usage quickly.
